subject.title: fix(sessions): let agents archive their session after completing a turn

question: Does the session-lifecycle owner approve the final rebased semantics for a self-archive request that waits through competing work, cancels on reset, and retries transient Gateway failures?
rationale: This is a protected session-state change whose safety depends on intended lifecycle policy rather than a mechanically provable local patch defect.

options.title: Approve protected lifecycle semantics
options.body: Confirm the deferred archive, cancellation, retry, and identity-guard behavior as the supported session lifecycle contract, then allow normal merge gates to evaluate the rebased head.

options.title: Narrow the lifecycle contract
options.body: Request a smaller behavior boundary if delayed retries or competing-work waiting should not become part of the sessions tool contract.

recommendation.title: Approve protected lifecycle semantics
recommendation.body: Confirm the deferred archive, cancellation, retry, and identity-guard behavior as the supported session lifecycle contract, then allow normal merge gates to evaluate the rebased head.
